gaps.term: Subroutine calls of the cited multiplier inside a fixed-tape machine
gaps.quote: Each call to it is an ordinary subroutine call; (cited)
gaps.note: The page states, as a cited claim, that the multiplier runs on the fixed-tape machine model and that each call is an ordinary subroutine call. It does not say what 'ordinary' means for the fixed tapes (whether tape contents, head positions or the machine's state carry across a call), so the reader cannot check how the multiplier's O(n log n) cost composes with the fixed-tape machine used by the argument.
